records.surface: Deposit vault role admin held behind the delay; multisig lacks it
records.onchain_observed: ICL 0x4691C475bE804Fa85f91c2D6D0aDf03114de3093 (shareToken() = reUSD): hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, Safe 0x8eec10616802Ef639CA55c98ac856553fAdEfBaD) = false; the Timelock 0x69dDEa332723cF5407151aAF68B9b076557FCA93 holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and UPGRADER_ROLE; getRoleAdmin(UPGRADER_ROLE) = DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, so granting UPGRADER_ROLE on this ICL waits the 48-hour delay.
records.documented_reference: docs.re.xyz (ICL permissions note): 'The Safe holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on every ICL (Ethereum reUSD and reUSDe, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Base), alongside the chain's timelock.' and '... so the Safe can grant itself ICL UPGRADER_ROLE with no delay'
